t: This is Sketch, a restaurant at 9 Conduit Street in Mayfair, which opened in 2003. It is owned by Mourad Mazouz, and the head chef is Pierre Gagnaire, whose cooking here is a loose adaptation of his three Michelin-starred Paris restaurant. Inside there are five eateries, including the Parlour, the Lecture Room and Library, the Glade, the Gallery, and the Eastbar and Pods. The Lecture Room and Library holds three Michelin stars. The building itself was designed by the architect James Wyatt.
